_comment: League defaults. The commissioner can override any of these when creating a league; nothing here is hardcoded in the engine.
_roster_note: 40-man rosters: the itemised active slots above (20 starters), a 15-man bench and 5 IL slots. The league settled this after the original rules quoted both an itemised 20 and a headline 23/45.
_waiver_run_weekdays_note: Weekdays pending FAAB bids clear, at midnight. 0=Monday. [0,2,5] is Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
_lineup_lock_note: Lineups for the week lock at this weekday and hour, local league time — Monday at noon, hours before that night's first replayed games.
_freeze_note: Rosters freeze when the playoffs begin — an add at that point is pure memory-sniping. freeze_adds_final_weeks additionally freezes the last N weeks of the regular season (0 = open).
_eligible_year_max_note: The span the injury export covers. A season outside it would replay without injuries, so the draw is held to years that have them. null => last completed season (current year - 1).
_excluded_years_note: 2020 was a 60-game season; it cannot fill a 22-week replay calendar. The pipeline coverage check may exclude further years at runtime.
_draft_pick_seconds_note: Seconds per pick before the draft room auto-picks for a manager. 0 waits forever.
